## Scene and result

Describe the location, camera, route, expected result and actual FPS/stutter.
Identify gameplay separately from menus, and native FPS separately from any
frame-generation result.

## Test conditions

- Build/package and `[BUILD]` marker:
- Comparison build or setting, if any:
- Switch model and handheld/docked mode:
- CPU / GPU / RAM clocks (include changes during the session):
- Renderer / FEX mode / launcher graphics profile:
- Game resolution and Advanced Options:
- Present mode from the log, if available:
- Launch mode and HUD:
- LSFG setting; include an LSFG-OFF baseline:
- Same scene/camera and warmed shaders in both runs?
- FPS overlay or measurement source:

## Evidence

Attach separate logs for each run and relevant screenshots. State when the
measured scene occurs in each log. Do not attach game files, keys or
proprietary shader payloads.
